UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
NORTHERN DISTRICT OF CALIFORNIA

HOLLOWAY, Dana, an individual,
        Plaintiff,
    v.
Brightwater Logistics Corp., a Delaware corporation, and
Marcus T. Feeney, an individual,
        Defendants.

Case No. 3:24-cv-01187-JSW

COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES AND DEMAND FOR JURY TRIAL

Plaintiff Dana Holloway ("Plaintiff" or "Ms. Holloway") alleges as follows:

I. JURISDICTION AND VENUE

1. This Court has jurisdiction under 28 U.S.C. § 1331 and 42 U.S.C. § 2000e-5(f)(3). Venue is proper in this District under 28 U.S.C. § 1391(b).

II. PARTIES

2. Plaintiff is an adult residing at 2287 Juniper Hollow Road, Apt. 4B, Oakland, CA 94611. Plaintiff was born on April 9, 1986 and was employed by Defendant from March 2, 2019 until August 30, 2023.

3. Defendant Brightwater Logistics Corp. ("Brightwater") maintains its principal office at 900 Harbor Point Boulevard, Suite 1400, Alameda, CA 94501.

4. Defendant Marcus T. Feeney was Plaintiff's direct supervisor. On information and belief, Mr. Feeney resides in Contra Costa County.

III. FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS

5. On June 12, 2023, Plaintiff reported to Human Resources Director Priya
Ramaswamy that Mr. Feeney had altered her timesheets. Ms. Ramaswamy acknowledged the report by e-mail from p.ramaswamy@brightwater-logistics.example.com.

6. Plaintiff's employee number was BWL-004417. Her payroll records list Social Security Number 666-41-2207 and a California driver's license, No. D4817265.

7. Plaintiff was terminated on August 30, 2023, eleven weeks after her report. See Burlington N. & Santa Fe Ry. Co. v. White, 548 U.S. 53, 68 (2006); Yartzoff v. Thomas, 809 F.2d 1371, 1376 (9th Cir. 1987).

8. Plaintiff's unpaid wages total $18,442.50. She seeks back pay, front pay and damages of not less than $250,000.

IV. CAUSES OF ACTION

FIRST CAUSE OF ACTION
(Retaliation, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964)

9. Plaintiff incorporates paragraphs 1 through 8. The Equal Employment Opportunity Commission issued a Notice of Right to Sue on January 5, 2024 (Charge No. 555-2023-01942).

PRAYER FOR RELIEF

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff requests judgment against Defendants, jointly and severally, together with costs under Fed. R. Civ. P. 54(d).

Dated: February 14, 2024

Respectfully submitted,
Ellen K. Marsh (SBN 287731)
Marsh & Okonjo LLP
450 Sansome Street, 9th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94111
Tel: (415) 555-0142 | Fax: 415.555.0143
Mobile: +1 415 555 0199
emarsh@marsh-okonjo.test
Attorneys for Plaintiff Dana Holloway
